text:
Asha: Heads up — sudden graupel/hail shower in Rockridge right now. BART slower, saw a couple scooters go down on College Ave. Anyone heading into the office? :umbrella::cloud_with_rain:

Diego: Yikes saw that on the walk — shoes soaked. BART says 15–25 min delays at MacArthur. :sweat_smile:

CommuteBot: BART Service Advisory — MacArthur to 19th St delays due to weather. https://status.bart.gov/incident/193456?ref=slack :train2:

Priya: I’m going to WFH today. Power flickered at home but fine now. If anyone needs a charger or umbrella, I can drop by later.

Sam: Office plants ok? tempted to brave it but thinking of staying local. @Asha are we open?

Asha: Office is open but totally flexible — don’t risk it. If you were planning a desk, we can free it up. Also quick poll: react with :one: if you’re heading in, :two: delayed, :three: WFH, :four: staying home and grocery run.

Alex: :two: leaving in 40, will try to dodge puddles.

Marisol: :three: I’ll be on Slack, can cover front desk video if needed.

Diego: :four: I need to run for a new pair of shoes. Anyone have a spare poncho?

Priya: We left a small emergency umbrella stash in the supply closet (3rd floor) after last winter — I can grab one later and drop it by the building entrance.

Asha: Thanks! Also FYI — if you’re on a scooter, slow down on the grates by College/Alcatraz, very slick.

Sam: @CommuteBot love the timely alerts. Also: anyone up for a quick video check-in at 10 in case we need to shuffle desks?

Marisol: I can do the 10. Also posting a photo of the scooter pileup in #incidents in case ops wants it.

Asha: Perfect. Stay safe y’all. If you’re local and need a hand with dry shoes/umbrella, DM me. :thumbsup:
